instructions.name: claim_timeout
docs: Rollup, permissionless. A Match that was delegated but never started before its start
deadline is cancelled, so `finalize` can refund both entries.

instructions.name: close_match
docs: Rollup. After the Match is over: closes the permissions and commits + undelegates
everything. The Books are not wiped: once committed they are public, which is how both
Players' picks become readable.

instructions.name: close_unstarted
docs: Rollup. A cancelled Duel never started, so it has no permissions: commits + undelegates
it as it is, which lets `finalize` refund both entries.

instructions.name: create_match
docs: Base layer. Binds a Duel to an Active tesoro_core Match of this Game and pre-funds the
ephemeral permission rent of its three accounts. Either Player may create it. The asset is
read from the Match id.

instructions.name: delegate_match
docs: Base layer. Delegates the Duel and both Books to the TEE validator.

instructions.name: end_match
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Once the window has closed: carries the line forward through any
column it did not reach, scores every column and decides the Match: more points wins,
equal points is a draw. It reads no price, so the result is the same whoever ends the
Match and whenever they do.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Base layer, permissionless. Settles the tesoro_core Match from the committed result by CPI,
signing as this Game's `authority` PDA: the winner takes the Pot minus fees. A draw, a
cancelled Match, or one never started before its start deadline refunds both entries.
`remaining_accounts` are the payout accounts tesoro_core expects.

instructions.name: init_permissions
docs: Rollup. Creates the permissions (the Duel is public, each Book private to its Player) and
starts the Match: the anchor price is read from the feed and recorded as the first sample,
the line enters the grid after the head start, and the Match runs for 2.5 minutes.

instructions.name: set_pick
docs: Rollup. Picks `band` (signed; 0 starts at the anchor) for `column`, or clears the pick with
`NO_PICK`. Only a Player, only until 10 seconds before the column starts. The pick stays in
the Player's own Book until the column locks.

instructions.name: tick
docs: Rollup, permissionless. Samples the oracle into the current column, reveals the picks of
every column that has locked, and scores the columns that are over. Clients call it
about four times a second; a sample is always a real price, so extra calls cannot fake a hit.

errors.name: NotAPlayer
errors.msg: Signer is not a Player of this Match

errors.name: NotEnded
errors.msg: The grid window has not ended

errors.name: BadPriceFeed
errors.msg: Not the price feed of this Match's asset

errors.name: StalePrice
errors.msg: The oracle price is stale or in the future

errors.name: BadTesoroMatch
errors.msg: The tesoro_core Match is not an Active Match of this Game

errors.name: AlreadyFinalized
errors.msg: Already settled or refunded in tesoro_core

errors.name: InvalidValidator
errors.msg: Delegation must name the TEE validator

errors.name: PermissionNotReady
errors.msg: A permission for this account is missing or is not a real permission

types.name: Account
docs: One Account's identity ledger. Balances mirror the sum of its Holdings, split by whether the
Gemas are own-sourced (Source owned by this Account) or won (any other Source).

fields.name: own_reserved
docs: Reserved for Offers (part of the totals, not free to enter Matches or redeem).

types.name: Book
docs: One Player's picks. Readable only by that Player while the Match runs, public once it is over.

fields.name: picks
docs: A band (signed, 0 starts at the anchor) per column, or `NO_PICK`.

fields.name: pick_count
docs: Columns with a pick right now.

fields.name: oracle_authority
docs: Trusted for now to supply the issuance price and `YieldAccrued`/`PositionLocked` facts.
This is the seam for the LayerZero receiver (messages) and Pyth (price).

fields.name: platform_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Platform Fee.

fields.name: leaderboard_bps
docs: Leaderboard Fee in basis points of the Pot. Appended after `games`: an account created
before it reads the fields as zero (the unused tail of the account is zeroed) and is
extended by `init_leaderboard`.

fields.name: pool_account
docs: The Leaderboard Pool: `TesoroAccount` owned by the `["leaderboard"]` address. Zero until
`init_leaderboard`; the fee is off while it is.

fields.name: leaderboard_since
docs: Unix time `init_leaderboard` first ran: Matches opened before it were not charged the fee, so
readers show the fee only for Matches opened at or after it. Zero until then.

fields.name: entry_sizes
docs: Entry sizes in Gemas, zero-padded. All zero until `set_entry_sizes`: the default 500 /
1,000 / 2,500 apply, so an older Config needs no call. Appended after the Leaderboard
fields: an account created before reads them as zero from its zeroed tail.

fields.name: oracle_locked
docs: Set by the admin on mainnet (`set_oracle_lock`): the oracle key can no longer register
Positions, report their yield or name an Advance's price (test-mode paths), so a stolen
oracle key cannot mint Gemas. Appended last: an older Config reads it as false.

types.name: Duel
docs: The public table. Readable by anyone during the Match; a Player's pick appears here only once
its column has locked.

fields.name: match_id
docs: Same id as the tesoro_core Match this Game settles. Bits 1 and 2 are the asset.

fields.name: players
docs: Seat 0 opened the tesoro_core Match, seat 1 joined.

fields.name: winner
docs: Winning seat, `DRAW`, or `NO_WINNER` until the Match is over.

fields.name: grid_at
docs: `starts_at + HEAD_START_SECS`: when the line enters column 0.

fields.name: anchor
docs: The price when the Match started, 1e-8 USD: band 0 begins here.

fields.name: step
docs: Band height, 1e-8 USD.

fields.name: last_tick
docs: Informational: the time of the last sample. No instruction reads it; clients use it to
notice that the Duel changed.

fields.name: revealed
docs: Picks per seat, public once their column has locked; `NO_PICK` before and for no pick.

fields.name: scores
docs: Points from the columns scored so far.

fields.name: game
docs: Identity of the Game (its program id).

fields.name: authority
docs: Only this key may settle the Game's Matches (a PDA of the Game program, or a server key).

fields.name: studio_recipient
docs: `TesoroAccount` that receives the Studio Fee.

types.name: Line
docs: A slice of Gemas of one Source moving into a Pot or a reservation.

fields.name: fees
docs: Fee terms snapshotted when the Match opened.

fields.name: deadline
docs: After this time anyone may refund the Match as abandoned / no-show.

types.name: Side
docs: One entrant. `funder == player` unless the entry is backed; then `share_bps` is the Player's
share of the surplus from the accepted Offer.

fields.name: authority
docs: Solana wallet that controls the Account.

fields.name: evm_address
docs: The EVM family address of the Account (zero until set).

types.name: Track
docs: What the price line did in each column: its lowest and highest recorded price (1e-8 USD).
`seen` is a bitmask of the columns that have data. See `engine::Track` methods for the rules.

fields.name: last
docs: The last price recorded, 0 before the first sample.

fields.name: last_col
docs: The column of that sample, -1 during the head start.
